parts.name: Cover
parts.Basic_description: The cover is the top lid of the trash can, made of HDPE plastic, typically rectangular with a curved surface.
parts.Functional_description: It serves to close the container, preventing odors from escaping and keeping pests out. It can be lifted or flipped open.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates or flips around a hinge or pivot point to open and close the trash can.

parts.name: Container
parts.Basic_description: The container is the main body of the trash can, made of HDPE plastic, with a tall rectangular shape.
parts.Functional_description: It holds and stores waste materials, providing the main volume of the trash can.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary during use but can be tilted when the trash can is moved or emptied.

parts.name: Base
parts.Basic_description: The base includes the wheel assembly at the bottom of the trash can, made of rubber and steel components.
parts.Functional_description: It provides stability and mobility, allowing the trash can to be easily moved or tilted for transport.
parts.Movement_description: The wheels rotate around an axle, enabling rolling motion when the trash can is tilted backward.
